messages:
Lee (Customer Success): Heads-up — onboarding ticket from a new customer on Private. They can create a service principal key via SSO but all generation calls return 403. UI shows scopes include 'inference' but API says missing scope. Repro attached below.

Morgan (Support): Ack. Can you paste the exact curl and error body? Also key id and whether this is a VPC/private or on-prem deploy.

Lee (Customer Success): Private (VPC). Key id: sk_live_01FZXXXXXXXX. Repro steps (on our staging with same RBAC):
```\n# generation call\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/text/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_01FZXXXXXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4x","input":"hello"}'\n```
Response:
```\n{"error":{"code":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing scope: inference"}}\n```

Morgan (Support): Hmm. UI shows the key scopes fine? screenshot?

Lee (Customer Success): Yep — UI says: Scopes: [inference, embeddings] for that key. But a GET on the admin keys API shows an empty scopes array: `GET /v1/admin/keys/sk_live_01FZXXXXXXXX` returns `{"id":"sk_live_01FZXXXXXXXX","scopes":[],"created_by":"sso:user:acme"}`. So mismatch between UI and backend enforcement.

Jordan (Security): Possible race between the SSO provisioner and the key-service. We shipped a tiny change last week to add a service_account flow. That change introduced a flag `scope_override` which defaults to `true` for service accounts — it was supposed to preserve parent-org scopes but may be clearing them. I'll look at the provisioner logs.

Riya (Platform Eng): On it. Reproduced locally in staging. When creating a key via SSO connector with `subject_type=service_account` we hit code path that calls `keyService.createKey(..., inheritScopes=false)` — bug: should be `inheritScopes=true`. Stack snippet: 
```\n// auth-provisioner handler\nif (principal.type === 'service_account') {\n  // accidentally disable inheritance for service accounts\n  options.inheritScopes = false;  // <- bad\n}\nkeyService.createKey(principal, options)\n```
This explains why UI (which reads org metadata) shows scopes but key record lacks them.

Morgan (Support): Nice catch. Can we hotfix? Customer is blocked on generation for prod.

Riya (Platform Eng): Short term mitigation: we can PATCH the key to add the missing scopes. Example API call (admin):
```\nPATCH /v1/admin/keys/sk_live_01FZXXXXXXXX\nContent-Type: application/json\n{\n  "scopes": ["inference","embeddings"]\n}\n```
That will immediately restore generation. I'm preparing a small script to backfill any keys created by the SSO path in the last 72h.

Lee (Customer Success): Customer ok with manual patch for now if we do it during low traffic. Please coordinate.

Jordan (Security): Longer term: we should revert the scope_override default or explicitly set inheritScopes=true for service accounts. I'll open a CAPA and add unit tests. Also we need to audit any keys created since the deploy.

Riya (Platform Eng): Created a PR to set inheritScopes=true and added integration test verifying service-account keys copy parent scopes. Will request expedited review.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued for review: PR#4821 -> env=staging :rocket:  (CI passed).

Riya (Platform Eng): Ran backfill on staging — found 12 keys missing inference scope. Patch script output:
```\nFound 12 keys; patching 12/12 -> OK\nsk_live_01FZXXXXXXX -> added [inference]\nsk_live_01FZYYYYYYY -> added [inference]\n...\n```
I'll run the backfill for the customer's prod key now (will coordinate maintenance window).

Morgan (Support): Thx. Can you paste notes I can send to the customer? Need plain language: what happened, workaround, ETA for permanent fix.

Lee (Customer Success): Draft note for customer:
"We're very sorry for the interruption. During provisioning of service-account keys via SSO we hit a bug that caused the key record to be created without copying the allowed 'inference' permission. This caused generation requests to be rejected with a 403. Workaround: we can patch your key to add the inference scope immediately. Engineering has a fix in review and we will run a safe backfill for affected keys. ETA for prod patch: ~2–4 hours pending review and maintenance window."

Jordan (Security): Filing INC-2026-45 and CA-2026-09 (auth-provisioner scope handling). Will attach repro logs and PR link.

Riya (Platform Eng): After merge, I'll schedule a canary deploy, run the backfill for prod, and follow up when complete.

Lee (Customer Success): Customer updated with workaround. Will wait for confirmation after prod backfill. Thanks all. :heart:
